messages:
anna_finance: :loudspeaker: Quick announcement on billing policy changes rolling out next month. We are introducing a sliding burst window and a phased removal of the legacy free-credit top-up. Major points below — read and share with your teams.

billing-bot: Automated summary: new 'sliding_burst_window' flag will be added to customer metering. Changes take effect 2026-05-01 UTC.

tom_prod: Quick q — how does "sliding burst window" differ from current burst behavior? Will it affect Dedicated customers?

anna_finance: Short answer: it smooths the short-term burst allowance based on a 15m sliding window instead of a fixed bucket reset. For Hosted API customers this reduces sudden overage spikes while preserving peak capacity. Dedicated contracts are unaffected by default; sales can opt-in customers to the new model for cost smoothing.

jess_support: Can we get a canned response for customers seeing different invoice amounts in May? Some will panic. :sweat_smile:

anna_finance: Yes — draft canned replies are in the KB (link below). Key message: no surprise punitive charges, invoices show "burst smoothing adjustment" as a separate line item for transparency. Also we are issuing prorated grace credits for active customers to ease transition.

chris_sre: What metrics should eng-sre watch? Are there new headers or meter events emitted?

anna_finance: eng runtime will emit meter events. New headers on responses: X-Redwood-BurstWindow and X-Redwood-SmoothingRatio. Meter events: "burst_window_start", "burst_window_adjustment". We'll add dashboards in Console under Billing -> Burst metrics.

anna_finance: Example meter query (Datadog):
```
avg:last_15m:sum:billing.tokens{customer_id:12345}.rollup(sum, 60) by {customer_id} / 900
```

billing-bot: Note: customers on legacy free-credit top-ups will receive a 90-day phase-out notice. Remaining credits will be converted to a one-time prorated invoice credit unless customer opts into a new small-business credit program.

jess_support: I can draft the support KB + canned reply. Ping me with the exact wording.

tom_prod: Any change to rate limit headers (429 behavior)? We had a customer integration fail overnight with strict retry logic.

anna_finance: No behavioral change to 429 semantics. Rate limiting still uses token bucket per-route. The smoothing only affects how overages are calculated for billing and how the temporary burst allowance is computed. We will, however, publish guidance for retry/backoff best practices in the SDK notes.

chris_sre: Timeline — when do we flip the default for Hosted customers?

anna_finance: Rollout plan: 2026-05-01 — opt-in testing for small subset; 2026-06-01 — default for new Hosted customers; 2026-07-01 — global default for legacy Hosted accounts with 30-day opt-out window. Dedicated customers unaffected unless explicitly migrated.

anna_finance: Action items for teams:
- support: publish KB + canned replies by 2026-04-20 (jess_support owns)
- eng-runtime: emit new headers/events and add dashboards by 2026-04-25 (chris_sre owns)
- sales/solutions: outreach plan for mid-market/enterprise customers by 2026-04-22
- finance: update invoice format to include "burst smoothing" line by 2026-05-01

jess_support: On it. Will draft and post for review by EOD 2026-04-18.

sam_ceo: Thanks Anna and folks — good approach. Keep customer-first messaging. :thumbsup:

anna_finance: Two more notes: 1) There will be a grace-credit conversion tool for customers to preview their converted balance (Console -> Billing -> Credit preview). 2) Legal has approved the notice language for the 90-day phased change.

billing-bot: Reminder: internal docs published at https://redwood.example/internal/billing/sliding-burst and customer KB at https://redwood.example/kb/billing/smoothing-policy

jess_support: Draft posted: https://redwood.example/drafts/support-burst-smoothing — please review and add comments.

tom_prod: Will the change affect cost-reporting in Console? Our customers use that for daily budgeting.

anna_finance: Console will show both raw token usage and "billing-adjusted" token totals for transparency. We'll add a toggle in the next Console release to display adjusted vs raw.

chris_sre: Adding smoke tests to ensure header presence on all API responses. I will also add an alert if burst_window_adjustment rate > 20% for top 100 customers.

anna_finance: Thank you. If anyone needs the slide deck for customer calls, ping me and I'll share.

sam_ceo: Appreciate the thorough rollout plan. One ask: make the migration opt-out for the first month to reduce churn risk.

anna_finance: Noted and accepted — we'll implement an explicit opt-out flow and email for the first month after migration.

jess_support: Leaving a checklist on the KB. Will send a summary to #sales and #customer-success after internal review. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: End of thread.
